A '''squad''' of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] was commanded by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Travi Pott]] during the [[Separatist War]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[unit]] suffered heavy losses while attempting to destroy [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatist]] [[Jammer/Legends|jamming beacons]] on [[Savrip Island]]. Six members of the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were [[Death/Legends|killed]], while half of the squad suffered severe burns and Pott lost two fingers.<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />
